claim.design: one prospectively frozen local-only candidate versus a frozen rg baseline on newly authored source tasks from one previously unused public repository

preservation.rule: Preserve every v1 file, failure, contaminated/unknown classification, checker and original public/dev split. Never invoke --custodian as a claim of unverified restricted access.

prospective_choices.compat_ranking: not_run_in_this_experiment; P8-003 handles the separate compatibility profile
prospective_choices.source_freshness: pristine source and empty per-arm product index before preparation; operating-system page cache is not cleared and is not called cold disk
prospective_choices.case_order: For each arm, existing runner repetition outer loop0..2; inner statistics::order(48,20261003+repetition) using the frozen original u64 xorshift Fisher-Yates algorithm. Retain stable input JSONL order separately. Seal the exact actual implementation-derived288 dispatch schedule before any new query drafting; synthetic schedule conformance is required before authoring.
prospective_choices.sample_unit: global source-task component; translations, paraphrases and repetitions never add independent N
prospective_choices.family_ids: ptv2.<reserved-repository-id>.f0001 through f0012; monotonically reserved before authoring; no salted/hash-searched ids
prospective_choices.split: prospective_temporal_test_only: every reserved family and all its variants are test-only; this is explicitly a new all-test sampling design, not v1 75/25 hash split; native schema uses its existing holdout split value with a distinct scheme annotation and protocol identity, without claiming v1 custody or hash-split compliance
prospective_choices.multi_family_relation: Any discovered same-task relation is disclosed and merged before sealing. If fewer than12 independent components remain, the planned12-family scope is not achieved; preserve quarantine and do not silently top up or present variants as independent.
prospective_choices.input_jsonl_order: f0001..f0012; within each family en_original, zh_translation, en_paraphrase, zh_paraphrase

roles.freeze_owner: root/integrator, may have engine history and may not change the sealed arm after body exposure
roles.author: fresh fork_none task with no participation in implementation/tuning of this candidate and no old holdout-body exposure
roles.gold_reviewer: different fresh fork_none task, not the author and not an implementation/tuning participant of this candidate; review fixed source before any ranking
roles.leakage_reviewer: may inspect explicit approved public DEV/OCE references and new tasks only after candidate freeze; never fetch protected or unknown old holdout bodies
roles.operator: runs only sealed commands and records all results; no tuning or gold editing
roles.results_reviewer: non-author reviewer independently replays raw and reviews scope; deterministic frozen scorer supplies core scores, no LLM-as-ground-truth
roles.access_disclosure: Same service/account/tools may make data technically readable. Role/context separation and a non-tuning declaration are not access controls. Record actual supplied prompts/reads and earliest exposure; do not claim knowledge of invisible model pretraining or unseen prior bodies.

repository_eligibility.mode: public source at a fixed commit; no private code or paid/live provider
repository_eligibility.selection: Before any task drafting, reserve exactly one metadata-qualified repository and fixed commit in the lock. Choose on public license, small supported source inventory and operational compatibility, never on query outcomes. Final selection and every metadata candidate rejected must be recorded before the author task starts.
repository_eligibility.exclusions: Build an exact identity/URL/alias/fork/source-commit exclusion manifest from all authorized corpus and provenance METADATA for known DEV, OCE and old held-out repositories, plus codecortex itself. Include the six public DEV repos, both cc-switch/Flask external repos and every additional metadata-disclosed historical repo. Do not open old heldout query/gold bodies. Unknown historical identities remain an explicit limitation, not a fabricated complete exclusion proof.
repository_eligibility.novelty: Selected upstream must not equal, alias, fork, mirror or simply vendor/copy a known corpus repository/module. Review upstream metadata/provenance and admitted file hashes for direct copying. New questions must target distinct source tasks and avoid same-task templates from the allowed public reference set. Unseen old-body relation graphs remain unknown.
repository_eligibility.source_policy: Use exactly the generic presealed scanner and source-admission policy for both arms. Lock the full admitted input inventory and excluded/generated/vendor/license reasons before tasks are drafted; no post-score filtering. No query, gold, protocol, checkpoint or answer file enters indexed source.

zero_lexical_definition.purpose: A deliberately strong, explicitly defined raw-token zero-overlap check for at least two natural English base queries, alongside human review; it does not redefine every semantic capability.
zero_lexical_definition.normalize: Unicode NFKC followed by full Unicode casefold, using the pinned Python runtime's unicodedata version.
zero_lexical_definition.tokens: Maximal consecutive Unicode alphanumeric characters, implemented by re.findall(r'[^\W_]+', normalized, flags=re.UNICODE); split underscores, retain digits, no stopword removal, stemming or score-dependent normalization.
zero_lexical_definition.comparison: For each designated English original query, require nonempty natural-language query tokens and zero exact-token intersection with the union of every accepted primary/supporting/alternative gold source span and its explicit relative paths and source symbol names. Record token sets, intersection and source-span hashes. At least one real independently reviewed hard negative must have a strictly greater token-intersection count than the gold union.
zero_lexical_definition.natural_language_review: Reviewer confirms coherent ordinary wording, unchanged task semantics across variants, no manufactured spelling, encoding, unnatural synonym puzzle or hidden path hints. Chinese text is not used to satisfy the English zero-overlap minimum merely because scripts differ.
zero_lexical_definition.scope_limit: This tests the declared exact-token predicate only, not stemming, semantic dissimilarity, full repository-wide zero overlap or proof of retrieval quality.

gold.required: Every answerable family has source-verified explicit primary/required supporting groups and true alternatives, byte spans and source hashes; missing legitimate equivalent answers are fixed by versioned non-ranking review before data seal. Two no-answer families require narrow explicit source/scope/version and independently justified absence.
gold.variants: All4 variants share exactly the same task, hard scope and gold groups; preserve language labels and map to one global family. Differences in wording are never extra statistical units.
gold.hard_negatives: Each answerable family records at least one actual source-located wrong but lexically closer/plausible alternative, why it is wrong and evidence. Negative-only/no-answer variants of a positive task belong to its component and cannot be counted as a fresh independent family.
gold.disagreements: Preserve initial drafts, reviewer findings, corrected revisions and quarantined material with hashes. Before any ranking, source-only corrections are allowed and versioned. After data seal/first query, no gold/category/split/alternative/denominator edits to rescue the run.
gold.review_status: No author self-acceptance. A deterministic schema/lock checker does not substitute for source/gold and semantic relationship review.

measurement.freeze: Exact candidate source/tree/inventory, real Cargo product/eval compiler-artifact binaries, features/profile/target/toolchain, entire runner/adapter/parser/scorer and actual artifact helper dependency closure, rg executable/version, config, environment class, command/schedule, schema/metric version, source-admission policy, budgets and network/provider settings must be locked before authoring.
measurement.two_seals: Candidate/measurement/repository-source seal precedes all new query/gold drafting. A later data seal adds reviewed query/gold/components/schema/source locks without altering candidate, source admission or measurement choices.
measurement.lock_domain: New v2 protocol/data/seals/results live only under artifacts/benchmarks/prospective-temporal-v2/. They must not mutate crates/scripts/workflows or the presealed source/validation inventory. Additional executed artifact helpers have their own complete map and before/after hashes; do not falsely call that map part of v13 validation_inventory.
measurement.independent_environment_data: Actual OS/CPU/RAM/kernel/toolchain details are observed and recorded against the presealed runner class. Arm environments must match; differences are reported and block incomparable claims. The observed hardware fields cannot be fabricated in advance.
measurement.one_attempt: One experiment consists of all288 scheduled requests; no best-of, silent retry, replacement candidate, label repair or newly selected slices. Any first real scheduled query consumes the attempt even if later infrastructure fails.
measurement.pre_query_failure: A failed download/setup may be retried with identical seals only when raw evidence proves no scheduled query was dispatched; retain all failed logs. If dispatch cannot be excluded, treat the attempt as consumed. Fixing product/measurement logic after bodies is not an operational retry.
measurement.raw_replay: Parsing, identity checking, metric recomputation and artifact recovery that issue zero new product queries are allowed and must be labelled verification of the original raw, never a rerun.
measurement.network: No live/paid providers, remote source uploading or private code. Clear provider secrets, seal local default/semantic-disabled config and record runtime lane/model absence. State precisely any network observations; do not claim syscall-zero evidence unless an actual bound observer produced it.

metrics.core: Use the exact frozen codecortex-native-v1 scorer and schema without formula changes. Preserve complete per-row status, hits/spans, raw paths and timing, availability, lane states, budgets and identity.
metrics.no_answer: Keep the exact frozen native scoring and normalized_no_match+zero-hits result. Independently report the raw response's empty result/partial/error observations. The current normalizer derives NoMatch from a complete empty response, and runner also converts Success+empty to NoMatch; normalized_no_match is not evidence of a raw explicit no-match status. A separate raw_explicit_no_match column may use only an actual documented observable raw field, never the normalized status: if the public payload has none, record unsupported/null and its reason, not false or a fabricated true. Partial/error/missing responses remain visible and cannot count as complete empty observations. No new raw-status contract or alternative scorer is introduced.
metrics.summary: Show every variant/repetition and family-balanced metrics: average repetitions then4 variants within family; equal weights across independent components. Answerable and no-answer denominators remain separate. Report query micro and fixed category means transparently; one repository cannot estimate between-repository generalization.
metrics.comparison: Candidate-minus-rg paired family deltas. Quality metrics and availability are descriptive, not a new automatic overall pass. No live semantic-benefit inference.

bootstrap.implementation: Pinned Python random.Random(seed), sorted component keys, B draws of N whole family clusters with replacement; preserve both arms/all variants/repetitions together; percentile nearest-rank endpoints ceil(.025*B)-1 and ceil(.975*B)-1.
bootstrap.sampling: Independently report answerable10-component and no-answer2-component strata. Fewer than2 eligible independent components or undefined denominator => inconclusive. With one purposively selected repo and only12 families, intervals are conditional exploratory precision descriptions, not population or broad G8 certification.

metrics.thresholds: Retain source/scope/version leakage0, critical deterministic correctness100% and identical scorer goldens as hard integrity conditions. nDCG absolute regression0.01 and PrimaryTop1 1percentage point are review triggers per09, not invented permissive thresholds or guaranteed acceptance. Valid bad quality remains valid bad quality; insufficient precision is inconclusive.
metrics.unsupported: All unavailable facets/graph metrics, Recall20 withtop10, live semantic arms,100k scale, tail latency and platform/release coverage are explicitly not_run/unsupported. Never fill them with0 or infer them from file hits.

state_machine.entry: No new body has been authored for this experiment.
state_machine.allowed: Protocol and metadata-only design/review; no new query/gold bodies.
state_machine.exit: Independent protocol review, final exact implementation/helper capability review, all prospective choices accepted.

state_machine.entry: P8-002/003 dependency receipts accepted; final actual candidate build and regressions accepted; product/measurement/repository-source locks are all non-null, independently verified and sealed before fresh role creation.
state_machine.allowed: Create fresh roles and permit source-only drafting/review using exact supplied materials.
state_machine.exit: 12 distinct tasks,48 variants and all source/gold/relations/coverage independently reviewed; preserve disagreements and revisions.

state_machine.entry: All48 rows/source spans/components and exact suite/schema locks fixed with independent receipts; data seal predates first query, and no candidate/source-admission/measurement choice changed.
state_machine.allowed: Run-specific non-ranking identity/integrity checks; no knobs or gold changes.
state_machine.exit: Independent release-to-execute review verifies both seals and non-null readiness gates.

state_machine.entry: First scheduled real query dispatched (or inability to rule out dispatch after a failure).
state_machine.allowed: Execute the remaining exact preregistered schedule and preserve all errors; raw-only verification.
state_machine.exit: Actual run completes or fails, original raw retained; no second product-query attempt.

state_machine.entry: Independent identity/raw/metrics replay and manual task-scope review completed against actual results.
state_machine.allowed: Archive, honest accepted/failed/inconclusive decision and public disclosure consistent with the temporal design.
state_machine.exit: Dataset retired for future tuned-candidate confirmation; all old v1 blockers retained.

acceptance.pre_authoring_blockers: Any unresolved candidate/helper/source lock, pending hard dependency, unknown required protocol field or unauthorized role invalidates authoring readiness. No placeholder is evidence.
acceptance.execution_blockers: Lock drift, input/gold contamination, incomplete schema/provenance/review, same-task leakage into DEV, source/version/scope invalidity, missing scheduled rows or invalid infra/protocol measurement cannot pass integrity acceptance.
acceptance.task_vs_quality: A genuine one-shot sealing/anti-overfitting exercise with valid complete evidence may satisfy P8-004's engineering scope even when quality is poor/inconclusive; that does not accept the candidate for release or close G8/P8-005+. Exact task disposition remains independent manual review, with original clauses/dependencies preserved.
acceptance.never: No future acceptance, task status change, v1 clean-count increase or body authoring is authorized by this draft.

supersedes_draft.reason: Non-author found declared request order differed from unchanged runner and raw explicit no_match was not actually exposed; clarify actual interface before any authoring/execution.
